priorityList.notes: Tiger's Fury on cooldown for the free energy; it costs nothing and the engine gates it on its own 30 second cooldown.
Keep Rake ticking; it is a strong bleed that costs no combo point.
At 5 combo points, Rip if it is not already ticking.
At 5 combo points with Rip already up, Ferocious Bite dumps them instead of capping out.
Shred builds combo points the rest of the time.

Claw is a fallback builder below level 22, before Shred is learned (druid.md audit finding 2). Shred (learn level 22) is dropped by rewriteRotationRanks below that level, leaving nothing castable at 20-21 without this line. The audit's own recommendation named spellranks.json's rank-1 id (1082, learn level 20); investigating that with the scratch test at level 20 found it does NOT actually cast under this engine build. sim/druid/claw.go's registerClawSpell() registers ONE spell with a hardcoded ActionID{SpellID: 9850} -- spellranks.json's own rank-5/level-58 Claw id -- called unconditionally with no per-rank loop at all, unlike sim/druid/shred.go (shredSpellID[rank]) and sim/druid/rake.go (rakeRank.id) in the same package, which both register one spell per rank the way the rank-rewrite system expects. request.go's rotation() only calls rewriteRotationRanks below api.MaxLevel ('the rotation was authored for exactly the ranks it already carries' at 60, so the rewrite is skipped there) -- every OTHER entry in this file is written at its level-60 rank (Shred rank5/9830, Rake rank4/9904, ...) for exactly that reason, so this line is written the same way, at 9850/rank5, the id the engine actually registers, rather than at the audit's rank-1 id. That makes it fire correctly at level 60 (see cast tables) and, below level 58, rewriteRotationRanks's family-based lookup (any id belonging to a ranked spell resolves to the CURRENTLY LEARNED rank, regardless of which specific rank id the source names) still rewrites it down to 1082-9849, none of which the engine ever registers -- so the line remains genuinely inert for the level 20-21 window it exists for, an engine gap (Claw needs the same per-rank registration Shred and Rake already have), not something fixable from the rotation lane. Left in at 9850/rank5 since it is both the textually correct current-max reference and the id that already works at 60; it becomes real below level 58 too the moment claw.go is fixed to register one spell per rank the way Shred and Rake do. Flagged for the engine lane.
